llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward educational image-prompt generator with no hidden execution, persistence, credential use, or network behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The manifest allows Read, Write, and Edit, which is broader than needed for pure prompt generation, but the artifact does not instruct broad file access or mutation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact set is markdown-only and contains no install scripts, executable files, package steps, or automatic setup behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions stay within prompt planning and formatting, with user questions only for missing topic, use case, page count, theme, or special requirements.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, credential/session handling, data exfiltration, or destructive actions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently describes generating notebook-style educational AI image prompts from user-provided knowledge topics, examples, themes, and layout rules.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability

llm.guidance: Installers should expect this skill to help produce Chinese educational notebook-style image prompts. Only allow file writing or editing if you explicitly want the agent to save or modify prompt files; otherwise its normal use should be conversational output only.
